name: Xiamen Voke Mold & Plastic Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Voke Mold & Plastic Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, design, manufacture, and sale of various injection molds in China and internationally. It offers car center console housing, car air vent housing, grille, engine connection body, high-gloss air vent panel, dual-color mold for car buttons, dual-color casing for automobile fuel tanks, automotive panel housing, steering wheel airbag, car dashboard housing, car instrument panel internal structural housing, car glove box housing, and automotive electric tailgate spring sleeve, used in automotive sector.
